lead: Nawaz Sharif has built a public profile as a Pakistani politician, born on 25 December 1949 in Lahore.
As of 2026, he is 76 years old, and his birth date places him under the Capricorn sign.
He has held the office of Prime Minister of Pakistan and Federal Minister for Defence and has been recognised with Ig Nobel Prize and Knight Grand Cross of the Order of St Michael and St George.
The sections that follow break down Nawaz Sharif's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Nawaz Sharif — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Nawaz Sharif was born on 25 December 1949 in Lahore, and holds Pakistani and British nationality.
Public records name his father, Muhammad Sharif and his mother, Shamim Bibi. He is a sibling of Shehbaz Sharif and Abbas Sharif.
He studied at Government College University and Punjab University Law College.
He is recorded as speaking Punjabi, Urdu and English.

sections.heading: Nawaz Sharif — Career and Professional Work
paras: Nawaz Sharif works primarily as a politician, cricketer, entrepreneur, lawyer and head of government.

He has held the following offices: Prime Minister of Pakistan (2013–2017), Federal Minister for Defence (2013–2013), Federal Minister for Finance (1993–1998), Leader of the Opposition (1993–1996), Chief Minister of Punjab (1985–1990) and Prime Minister of Pakistan (1990–1993). He is affiliated with Pakistan Muslim League.

He has taken part in 2017 SCO Summit, World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2014, World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2015, World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2016 and World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2017.
